cohort: The study included 10 pregnant rabbits divided into two groups (normal diet vs. hyperlipidemic diet), from which a total of 30 pups were obtained after Caesarean section.
finding: The hyperlipidemic diet induced aortic and endothelial cell damage, increased fatty streaks and foam cells in pup aortas, and led to lower birth weights, suggesting atherosclerosis can begin in utero, with U-II playing a role.
birth_weight: The birth weights of the hyperlipidemic group were lower than the control group.
